New to Apple. But Not New to Tech. iOS 27's 'New' Features Already Existed

thread // Jun 11, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Read more on Threads

NEW TO APPLE. BUT NOT NEW TO TECH.

When Apple showed off iOS 27 at WWDC in June, a few of the "new" features looked very familiar. So I made the receipts. Google did most of them back in 2017. Splitwise did one in 2011.

1. Visual AI: point, scan, ask

Apple: Siri in the camera. Point your iPhone at something, scan it and ask about it.

Before Apple: Google Lens, which launched on the Pixel 2 on October 19, 2017.

Useful? Absolutely. But it's about eight years late. Smart, or just familiar?

2. Bill splitting

Apple: point Siri at a receipt, and it can pick out the items and split the bill with your friends using Apple Cash.

Before Apple: Splitwise, which launched on August 1, 2011.

I've used Splitwise since my college days. Convenient, or just late?

3. Parental controls

Apple: a redesigned Screen Time, with Time Allowances (daily limits by app category, with suggestions based on your kid's age), Schedules for when apps are available, weekly usage summaries and Ask to Browse, so kids can request websites that aren't approved yet.

Before Apple: Google Family Link, from March 2017, which already let parents set daily limits, bedtimes and app approvals.

Why this keeps happening

Apple is rarely first, and it doesn't try to be. It waits, watches what works, then builds a polished version right into the iPhone and presents it like it's brand new. For people who are new to Apple, it really is new. For everybody else, it's a feature we've been using for years, just with better marketing.

That's not all bad. Built-in usually means easier. But "new" and "new to Apple" aren't the same thing.

Update (September 2026)

iOS 27 is out now. Apple released it on September 14. A couple of corrections to my original post: Apple's name for the camera feature is Siri Mode (it's a rebrand of Visual Intelligence), not "Siri Camera," and the bill splitting runs through Siri Mode and Apple Cash. The parental controls aren't called "Family Dashboard" either: it's a redesigned Screen Time with Time Allowances, Schedules and Ask to Browse, and it needs every device in your Family Sharing group updated to the new versions.

Sources: MacRumors, 9to5Mac on the Screen Time changes, TechCrunch, Tom's Guide

Quick answers

When did iOS 27 come out? September 14, 2026.

What is Siri Mode in iOS 27? The new name for Apple's Visual Intelligence camera feature: point your camera at something and ask Siri about it. It can also read receipts and split bills with Apple Cash.

Did Google Lens come before Apple's camera AI? Yes. Google Lens launched on the Pixel 2 in October 2017.

When did Splitwise launch? In 2011.

What's new in Screen Time in iOS 27? A redesign with Time Allowances for daily limits by app category, Schedules, weekly usage summaries and Ask to Browse for website requests.
